shell_commands: ls eslint* 2>/dev/null; ls .eslintrc* 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "test-imports-its-subject" --include="*.ts" --include="*.js" --include="*.cjs" --include="*.mjs" --include="*.json" -l . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -20
grep -rn "test-imports-its-subject" eslint.config.mjs scripts/ tools/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -20
grep -rn "test-imports-its-subject" . --include="*" -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head; echo ---; ls node_modules | grep -i re-lint; ls node_modules/eslint-plugin* 2>/dev/null
ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo "---"; cat package.json | head -60; echo "---"; cat .lore/test-commands.yml 2>/dev/null
grep -n "ErrorCodes" src/types/session.ts | head; echo ---; ls scripts/ ; echo ---; grep -rn "spec:" src/types/*.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5
grep -rn "specs/hal-engine" src/transport/messageHandler.test.ts | head -8; echo ---; grep -rn "spec" scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs | head -20
git status --short && git log --oneline -6 && echo --- && ls src/transport/ src/types/
grep -rn "messages.test" --include="*.md" --include="*.yml" --include="*.json" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head; echo ---; sed -n 1,40p scripts/lore-run-test.mjs
npx prettier --write src/types/messages.test.ts && grep -n "" src/types/messages.test.ts | sed -n '25,28p'
git branch --show-current && git status --short && git log --oneline -1 origin/$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null || true

git add .lore/dod.md src/types/messages.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(types): load the pin's subject, one expect

The fixture eslint flagged loaded nothing real - its import was
type-only, erased at runtime - and held two expects. It now
value-imports ErrorCodes from ./messages.js, which the error frame
uses, and asserts one object with toEqual. The it keeps its title
and line, so section 3's citation needs no re-pointing.

Refs #144

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main 2>&1 | tail -2; git log --oneline -1 origin/main; git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main
git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD && echo "origin/main is contained in HEAD - no merge needed"; git status -sb | head -2
